answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nadir of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the raven until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the saffron of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, revoked by a single upheld challenge, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
